adjudicated.jp: がくん、と体が突き押された気分だった。
adjudicated.en: Twang, then the feeling of my body being pushed through.
comments: He then speaks of blood falling down below his feet, so I don't think he collapsed yet. The entire following is probably no more than a few seconds anyway. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: がくん is a sudden jolt or lurch, not the sound 'twang,' and 突き押された describes the body feeling abruptly shoved, not pushed through something.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'With a jolt, it felt as though my body had been shoved.'
